paragraphs.text: Makes small text in a screenshot readable before a model reads it: crop a region, magnify it with a
chosen kernel, hand back a new image. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin + standalone CLI.
# dsh-crop-zoom
**Magnify a region of an image so small text becomes readable.**

A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin that registers a
`crop_zoom` tool, plus the same engine as a stand

s (`dsh`) plugin that registers a
`crop_zoom` tool, plus the same engine as a standalone CLI.
中文说明 →

- Local image processing only — no network, no model call, no OCR engine.
- One dependency: `sharp`

(libvips), loaded lazily so a missing native build can never stop the harness from booting.
- Node ≥

, loaded lazily so a missing native build can never stop the harness from booting.
- Node ≥ 22. MIT.
## The problem this solves

A 1920×1080 screenshot does not reach a model at 1920×1080. It is downscaled on the way
in, so a 10–

11px item label arrives with its strokes already fused — and re-reading the
same screenshot cannot b
ring those pixels back.
Four readings off one status screen, every one of them wrong in the same way:
| Printed | Came back as | Why |

| `03重型盔` | `D3重型盔` | at 11px the `0` and the `D` share one left stem |
| `BT6重型` | `B16重型` | the `T

` welds itself onto the `B` before it |
| `1000戰地包` | `100D戰地包` | four digits merge into three plus

a letter |
| `鎏影權鋒` | `盜影權杖` | the 金 under 鎏 collapses into something 皿-shaped |

Those characters are perfectly legible once the region is cropped out and upscaled.
Doing that *befo

re* the text is read is the only reliable order of operations, and it
costs far less than pushing th
e whole screenshot through again.

## Using the tool
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The tool writes PNG file(s) and returns their paths; read the result with `read_image`.
The text it

returns is geometry only — deliberately, so it cannot be mistaken for the
answer:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Parameters
| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `path` | string | — | Absolute path to the source image. Required. |
| `regions` | array | — | 1–8
regions, in sheet order. Required. Each is `{x, y, width, height, label?}` in **source** pixels. |

| `scale` | integer | — | Integer magnification, 1–16. Omit to derive it from `target`. |
| `target`
| integer | `1600` | With no `scale`, magnify until the region's longer edge reaches this many pixe

ls, capped at 16×. |
| `mode` | enum | `bicubic` | `bicubic` \| `nearest` \| `lanczos` \| `mitchell`

. |
| `sheet` | boolean | `true` | Stack every region into one labelled PNG. `false` writes one file

per region. |
| `outPath` | string | temp dir | Where to write; must end in `.png`. |
| `previewWid
th` | integer | — | Set this when the coordinates were measured on a downscaled preview: pass that p
review's pixel width and every coordinate is rescaled to the source automatically. |

`bicubic` preserves glyph outlines and is the right default. `nearest` replicates whole
pixels, whic

h is what separates a `0` from a `D` — the two are complements, so when a
character still will not r
esolve, look at it both ways.
### CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## How it works

1. Decode the source once into memory. Regions are bounded against the *display* size
(after EXIF ro

tation), so an upright photo is cropped where it looks upright.
2. `extract` each region, then `resi

ze` by an integer factor with the selected kernel —
integer scaling avoids resampling artefacts on e

xactly the strokes you are trying to read.
3. Optionally composite the pieces into one sheet, captio

ned with the geometry of each
region, so a multi-region check costs one follow-up read rather than s

h the geometry of each
region, so a multi-region check costs one follow-up read rather than several.
## Limits

- **Local files only.** Remote URLs are not fetched; that keeps the tool from becoming an
outbound r

equest channel on the model's behalf.
- Output is always PNG.
- 8 regions and 16× per call.
- Sheet

captions are ASCII; non-Latin caption text depends on the fonts fontconfig
exposes to librsvg, so pu

t non-ASCII descriptions in the region `label` rather than
expecting them on the image.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`test/run.mjs` builds its own synthetic image and asserts exact output geometry.
`test/plugin.mjs` e

xercises `apply()` against a stub `ctx` and checks that a throwing
registry cannot escape.
